INSERT INTO tbl_OTC_AllTrades_Final 
( trade_id, transfer_id, event_type, transfer_status, transfer_type, Transfer_Amount, SettleCurrency, 
value_date, PayerCode, ReceiverCode, [PO_Settle_Method], Settle_Amount, Original_Cpty, PayerRole, PayerInst, 
PayerInst_Status, ReceiverRole, ReceiverInst, ReceiverInst_Status, netted_transfer, settle_date, TRADE_KEYWORD_source, 
Book_Attr_MO_Email, Processing_Org, book_name, payreceive_type,LoadDate )
SELECT InternalsWithABAs.trade_id, InternalsWithABAs.transfer_id, InternalsWithABAs.event_type, InternalsWithABAs.transfer_status, 
InternalsWithABAs.transfer_type, InternalsWithABAs.Transfer_Amount, InternalsWithABAs.SettleCurrency, InternalsWithABAs.value_date, 
InternalsWithABAs.PayerCode, InternalsWithABAs.ReceiverCode, InternalsWithABAs.[PO_SETTLE_METHOD] , InternalsWithABAs.Settle_Amount, 
InternalsWithABAs.Original_Cpty, InternalsWithABAs.PayerRole, InternalsWithABAs.PayerInst, InternalsWithABAs.PayerInst_Status, 
InternalsWithABAs.ReceiverRole, InternalsWithABAs.ReceiverInst, InternalsWithABAs.ReceiverInst_Status, InternalsWithABAs.netted_transfer, 
InternalsWithABAs.settle_date, InternalsWithABAs.TRADE_KEYWORD_source, InternalsWithABAs.Book_Attr_MO_Email, InternalsWithABAs.Processing_Org, 
InternalsWithABAs.book_name, InternalsWithABAs.payreceive_type,LoadDate
FROM tbl_OTC_InternalsWithABAs InternalsWithABAs
LEFT JOIN tbl_OTC_AllTrades_Final AllTrades_Final ON InternalsWithABAs.trade_id = AllTrades_Final.trade_id
WHERE AllTrades_Final.trade_id Is Null
ORDER BY InternalsWithABAs.event_type DESC;

DECLARE @ActualInserted int 
SET @ActualInserted = 
(
SELECT COUNT(*)  
FROM dbo.tbl_OTC_AllTrades_Final
)


SELECT @ActualInserted AS CountInsertedRows
